items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: And they announced our band every night

ctx.x: Yes. Both of them were from England. And they were ballroom dancers. And they announced our band every night and they were so immaculate and we were dressed in all, we bought so many different uniforms. We had eight or ten different uniforms.
We had white tails, black tails and grey tails. White suits. (LAUGHTER).
